verdict.rationale: ADK's docs say developers can scaffold, build, test, evaluate, and deploy agents with the official Agents CLI from an AI-enabled environment. They also say coding assistants can connect to ADK developer Skills, so official agent-driven scaffolding exists. However, the pack never shows the actual scaffold command, its template output, or proof that it is a single command. missing for 10: a documented one-command scaffold invocation (e.g. a create/init subcommand), a description of the generated project template, hands-on or independent corroboration of a coding agent running it.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a coding agent scaffold a new agent project from an official CLI or template in one command

citations.quote: Use your favorite AI-enabled developer environment to scaffold, build, test, evaluate, and deploy with Agents CLI.
ADK is designed to be written by both humans and AI. Connect your favorite coding assistant to our ADK developer Skills and AI-aware developer resources
